learning_outcomes.text: Explain the role of vision in robotic perception and the image formation basics
Describe feature detection, matching and their uses
Explain object detection and segmentation at a conceptual level
Reason about depth perception from stereo, structured light and other cues
Describe pose estimation and visual servoing for manipulation
Identify real-world vision pitfalls such as lighting, occlusion and latency

integrative_case: A robotics team builds a bin-picking cell: choose and calibrate cameras, decide between detection and segmentation, recover object pose for the gripper, and make the system robust to changing warehouse lighting and partial occlusion.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
